claims.claim: Heavy-duty MAN Diesel 10 Tyre Dump Truck

A video showing the tipper bed being fully raised and lowered.

risks.risk: Chassis structural damage or heavy corrosion
risks.proof: Clear photos of the chassis rails, suspension mounts, and undercarriage.
Close-up photos of all 10 tyres showing tread depth and sidewall condition.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and the truck driving.
Video of the tipper mechanism in full operation.
Photos of the cab interior, dashboard, and odometer.
Clear photos of the chassis and the VIN/manufacturer's plate.
response.reason: The vehicle is clearly identified as a MAN 26.372 dump truck. It will be priced at its worst-case mechanical state (non-running) until proof of operation is provided.
